renderer: deterministic inline SVG detached relay ledger
commitThreshold: bent pressure relay between two different outer seams; same-seam, weak, or straight paths refuse
primitiveBudget: nine detached generated SVG deposits, four outer seams, one produced relay path per accepted transfer, and four liftable global remakes
memoryRule: each accepted relay re-produces every deposit from ordered pressure, counterpressure, and shear; relay order changes the next ledger and lift restores the prior field
interactionRule: pointer or touch starts near one outer seam, bends through the field, and releases near another; ArrowLeft/ArrowRight selects; Enter/Space relays; Delete lifts latest; Escape or R releases; S downloads
representationRupture: radial ring, relief tablet, vacancy register, and continuous membrane -> nine detached inline SVG deposits with no enclosing surface
compositionRupture: centred bodies and broad skin -> broken diagonal constellation with a large unoccupied middle and no cells or grid
encounterRupture: phase timing, select-and-cut, edge-to-edge crossing, and settled membrane passage -> bent two-seam pressure relay
temporalRupture: local, subtractive, vacancy, and drying memory -> ordered transfer memory that globally remakes detached pieces
mediumRupture: p5.js Canvas 2D rings, reliefs, plates, and membranes -> generated inline SVG paths, gradients, masks-free geometry, and DOM pointer events
changedRule: A bent relay between two different outer seams transfers the production rule through every detached deposit; a local stroke is never stored.
visibleConsequence: The blind view is nine separate pigment deposits in a broken field. A valid relay moves, tilts, and re-scales all nine pieces and adds a produced seam; four relays compound and remain liftable.
falsifier: Delete if a same-seam, weak, or straight gesture commits; if only the relay line or readout changes; if any deposit remains fixed; if order is cosmetic; or if lifting is inexact.
deletionCondition: Delete v054 if caption-free viewing cannot distinguish detached relay material from v050-v053's bodies, registers, and membrane, or if the p5.brush translation is only explanatory prose.
promotion: candidate / held pending local and production browser matrices, independent caption-free perceptual review, and provider revision linkage
